title: Even or Odd
description:
Ask for a number. Print `even` if it is divisible by 2, otherwise print `odd`.

**Input:** `7`

**Expected output:**
```
odd
```
starterCode:
n = int(input())
# Print even or odd
hint: Use n % 2 == 0 to check if n is even. If n % 2 == 0, print 'even', else print 'odd'.
